verdict.rationale: A hands-on community user confirms n8n keeps all historical executions, showing what happened when workflows failed and the data in and out of each node. The pricing page lists "Execution search", and error workflows let you control the response to failures, so the inspection half of the story is well supported. Missing for 10: any evidence of re-running a failed execution, resuming from the failing step, and first-party docs on execution logs.
